summary.intent: Resolve all open Copilot PR review comments on the phase-39 branch (user-configurable vault parameters), then clean up dead code identified during review.
summary.outcome: All 11 review threads across two rounds were triaged, fixed where valid, and resolved. Dead `retentionDays` field in `useBinStore` was fully removed after confirming no live consumers remained.

repo: Phase 39 introduces user-configurable vault parameters; recycleBinRetentionDays min was changed from 1 to 0 per requirement D-03.
TEE IPNS key enrollment must follow the StorageTab pattern: wrap keys before calling createAndPublishIpnsRecord, mirroring the existing BYO config flow.
useBinStore.retentionDays was a write-only dead field after useBin.ts was refactored to read directly from useVaultSettingsStore — no consumer ever read it from the bin store.
The phase-39 branch was missing commit 560c871fe from phase-38 which removed a @cipherbox/core circular dependency in vault-ipns.test.ts; required cherry-picking the fix manually during merge.

pnpm lockfile showed ~15k lines of churn after merging main due to YAML inline vs expanded formatting difference between branch bases — content was identical, cosmetic only; squash-merge to main resolves it.
STATE.md was overwritten by the merge from main (which had phase-38 state), requiring manual correction back to phase-39 progress.

code.finding: Min value for recycleBinRetentionDays changed from 1 to 0 to allow 'keep forever' / no purge semantics per D-03.
TEE enrollment (wrapping IPNS private key with TEE public key) was missing before createAndPublishIpnsRecord call; added to match StorageTab pattern.
retentionDays now sourced directly from useVaultSettingsStore, making the useBinStore.setRetentionDays write path redundant.
setTimeout for save debounce lacked cleanup on unmount; fixed with useRef + clearTimeout in useEffect return.
retentionDays field and setRetentionDays action fully removed — field was write-only dead code after useBin.ts refactor.
Test asserted clamp(0) => 1 (old min=1 behavior); updated to expect 0 after min was changed; also added negative-value test case.
JSDoc comment said range 1-365; updated to 0-365 to match implementation change.
New test file created with 5 tests for deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair; split from vault-ipns.test.ts to avoid pre-existing @cipherbox/core import resolution failure.

workflow: When a branch is missing commits from a sibling branch, cherry-pick or manually apply rather than re-implementing; checking git log on both branches reveals the gap quickly.
For Copilot review threads, use GraphQL reviewThreads query to batch-fetch, then reply via REST (--field for integer in_reply_to) and resolve via GraphQL mutation.
pnpm lockfile merge churn from YAML format differences is cosmetic; verify with a content diff before investigating further.
Running tests on a new file in isolation confirms whether failures in the existing file are pre-existing vs introduced.

friction: vault-ipns.test.ts had a pre-existing @cipherbox/core import resolution failure that blocked running tests; required splitting new tests into a separate file and later manually applying the fix from the phase-38 branch.
Merging main overwrote STATE.md with stale phase-38 state, requiring manual correction.
pnpm lockfile showed 15k lines of churn post-merge, causing alarm before investigation revealed it was purely cosmetic YAML formatting.
CI caught a missed test update (vault-settings.test.ts asserting old min=1 behavior) that local test runs didn't surface because the test file runs in a different package.
User interrupted a commit mid-flow to run pnpm lint:fix, requiring stash/unstash around the merge.
open_items: VaultTab.tsx preset buttons (thread 5) are deliberately unimplemented — design simplification for phase 39, not a bug.
useAuth.ts still calls the useAuth store for bin operations (non-retentionDays); the useBinStore import remains and should be audited in a future pass for further consolidation.
pnpm lockfile formatting inconsistency between branch bases should be normalized (run pnpm install on a clean branch) to avoid future merge noise.
39-04-SUMMARY.md and types.ts JSDoc were updated reactively via review; a doc audit pass for all phase-39 docs would be worthwhile before merge.
